title: Introducing Whatnot Liveplex: NYCC’s Live Shopping Mall
summary: This year, Whatnot will bring live shopping to the center of New York Comic Con (NYCC) with the debut of the Whatnot Liveplex, a 5,000-square-foot, shopping mall-inspired activation at the Javits Center. From October 8–11, the Liveplex will spotlight the people shaping what’s next in comics, collect
body_markdown:
For Whatnot sellers, NYCC is one of the biggest weekends of the year. Spanning creators, artists, and collectible brands, sellers are partnering with the top names in the industry to create one-of-a-kind shows for their buyers. The Liveplex will give sellers the opportunity to go live and sell right from the floor, including those without a standalone booth at the convention.


Seller programming includes:


**Thursday, October 8**


-


**10:00am - 11:00am: Todd McFarlane** will release a signed two-pack of NYCC-exclusive comics celebrating the announcement of Spawn’s appearance in the *Diablo Immortal* video game franchise.


-


**2:00pm - 3:30pm:** **Comic Sketch Art** will feature Brett Bean, creator of Image Comics’ ** hit series *D’Orc,* for live signings.


**Friday, October 9**


-


**12:00pm - 2:00pm: Trinity Comics and Czarface** will debut an exclusive comic accompanying Czarface’s album release. Zoe Lacchei will also sell an exclusive edition of *Absolute Batman #24* .


-


**2:15pm - 3:45pm: Comic Sketch Art** will feature Ryan Ottley, co-creator of *Invincible* , for live signings and an exclusive drop of his first-ever *Absolute Batman* cover.


-


**4:00pm - 5:00pm: VeeFriends with Gary Vaynerchuk** will be selling something *giant* (to be announced!).


**Saturday, October 10**


-


**10:00am - 11:30am: AC Comics and Clayton Crain** will debut an exclusive five-cover connecting box set for *Absolute Batman* , along with a blind-bag release of Crain’s *Out of Hell* .


-


**12:00pm - 2:00pm: Trinity Comics** will host a live signing and art exhibition with legendary Marvel artist **Peach Momoko** .


-


**2:00 - 3:30pm: Plastic Empire** and Pixar Art Director **Ben Su** will launch their *Dungeon Crawler Carl* NYCC-exclusive blind bag.


-


**4:00pm - 5:00pm: PSA** will celebrate “10/10 Day” with host **Arris Quinones** **and Gary Vaynerchuk** , featuring the slabbed Mass Appeal x PSA NYCC Whatnot Exclusive Blind Box.


### **Where Hip-Hop, Comics and Collectibles Collide**
